label: Maximum share of the curtilage that buildings other than the original house may cover after a permitted-development extension
quote: (b) as a result of the works, the total area of ground covered by buildings within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse (other than the original dwellinghouse) would exceed 50% of the total area of the curtilage (excluding the ground area of the original dwellinghouse);
scope: England. The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A, paragraph A.1(b): development is not permitted by Class A if it would take coverage above this share. Stated in the lowriskquotes conservatory cost guide as 'do not cover more than half the garden'.
